description: "Pilgrimages to the Spas in Pursuit of Health and Recreation" by James Johnson is a travelogue written in the early 19th century. This book provides an insightful exploration of various mineral springs in Germany and their supposed health benefits, while also reflecting on the experiences of English travelers seeking rejuvenation.
